digest: Investigation confirms that the reported critical malware and ransomware attack on BUILD-LAB-03 was a scheduled detection-validation exercise (CHG-4821) conducted in an isolated cyber-range environment. No actual malicious activity, credential theft, or data encryption occurred, and all simulated network traffic remained internal.

evidence_findings.title: Scheduled Detection Validation Exercise
evidence_findings.subject: Case 2101
evidence_findings.evidence: This is the scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821 in the isolated BUILD-LAB network. The SOC lead approved the exact simulation from 13:00 through 14:00 UTC.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The case is a planned simulation, not a real incident.

evidence_findings.title: Activity Linked to Approved Change
evidence_findings.subject: Service Account svc_detection_test
evidence_findings.evidence: Execution was initiated by service account svc_detection_test under approved change CHG-4821.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated activity was authorized and part of a controlled exercise.

evidence_findings.title: No Actual Malicious Activity
evidence_findings.subject: BUILD-LAB-03
evidence_findings.evidence: EDR recorded simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred. Binary hash matches the internally signed validation tool inventory.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated ransomware and credential theft did not result in actual compromise or data loss.

evidence_findings.title: Internal Network Traffic Contained
evidence_findings.subject: Network Traffic
evidence_findings.evidence: Destination is the internal exercise controller (10.250.0.10). Firewall confirms the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.
evidence_findings.conclusion: Simulated C2 beacon traffic was contained within the isolated lab environment and did not egress externally.

attack_chain.description: A process named 'attack-simulator.exe' was executed on 'BUILD-LAB-03' by 'svc_detection_test' as part of a simulated ransomware scenario.
The simulation included a credential theft scenario, though EDR confirmed no actual credential access occurred.
Simulated C2 beacon traffic was observed from '10.250.0.23' to the internal exercise controller '10.250.0.10' on port '8443'.
A ransomware scenario was simulated, but EDR confirmed no file encryption or payload download took place.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Case created, marking the start of the scheduled exercise window.
Simulated C2 beacon traffic from '10.250.0.23' to '10.250.0.10'.
Analyst comment confirming the scheduled detection-validation exercise.

ioc_indicators.context: Simulated ransomware tool used in the exercise.
Internal IP address of the exercise controller 'SIM-CONTROLLER-01'.
Internal IP address of 'BUILD-LAB-03' simulating C2 beacon.
Service account used for authorized simulation activity.
Approved change request for the detection validation exercise.

remediations.description: Close this case as a False Positive due to it being a scheduled and approved detection validation exercise.
Review the alert logic that triggered this case to ensure future simulations are automatically identified as benign or suppressed, if appropriate.
